This week marks the start of our final presentations. Thank you to those who have already signed up for a timeslot. If you have not yet done so, please do so now: [presentation sign-up sheet](`r project_signup_link`)

Please note: **IT IS REQUIRED (not optional)** to sign up and present synchronously. Apart from exceptional circumstances that we have discussed and agreed upon before now, we will not accept recordings. 

Reminder that details on the project, including the grading rubric, is available here: [/assignments/project.html](https://`r paste0(tolower(semester), year)`.data606.net/assignments/project.html).

An example project slide deck is available [here](/slides/Example_Project_Slides.html) ([PDF](/slides/Example_Project_Slides.pdf)).

Some important information about each presentation session:

* Please turn on your cameras!
* You have no more than 10 minutes.
* If your abstract is in your slide deck, please don't read it.
* Complete the peer feedback form for each presentations.
* Submit a PDF of your slides and abstract to BrightSpace.
